fact: The Ministry of Transport and Communications issued Botswana's National Broadband Strategy (final, June 2018), stating that the Government has developed it with targets of 2 Mbps for 50% of citizens by end 2014 and 20 Mbps for 90% of the population by 2018, with the Information Age Council to guide implementation and monitor progress; the document gives no separate adoption date, so the date used is its June 2018 publication.
